title: H22 isolated missing source import-digest control
intent: Resolve the isolated H22.02 evidence gap without changing observer behavior or the C260 contract.

requirements.acceptance: Author isolated actual source import-digest removal from the unchanged historical input, with unchanged companion source and GLB, predeclared exact refusal expectation from adopted rules, input hashes and an independent construction explanation before invoking the observers.

Execute positive baseline and isolated missing-digest variants through applicable source observation, binding and comparison interfaces. Preserve complete actual responses, input identities and reasons. Require the independently frozen typed refusal and no qualified partial result; preserve contradictions without repairing runtime or changing the oracle.

Independently review the exact candidate and evidence; resolve mandatory findings. Before integration execute the complete affected regression inventory, required local driver and applicable documentation/workflow checks, retaining all failures, interruptions and environment limits.
In a later phase acquire verified expected-head ownership, conditionally integrate the reviewed candidate, verify actual main and observe branch disposition with retained history.

requirements.description: Verified phase delivery and truthful closure
requirements.acceptance: Confirm early recovery before substantial work. Verify and save each phase handoff and matching prompts; publish its separate receipt. Keep parent and scope issue open until every requirement, integration and final delivery gate passes.
